analysis_set.span: The efficacy objectives were evaluated in all randomized patients using analysis of time from randomization to the first event.

follow_up.span: From the date of randomization and up to completion of the end-of-treatment visit (Month 60) or at study closure

entry_age.span: Adult patients (≥18 years) considered at high risk for a future cardiovascular event were eligible to participate.

notes: The follow-up span is from registry RESULT OUTCOME 2, the served three-component cardiovascular composite; Month 60 is the specified assessment window, not an observed follow-up duration. Its population is explicitly Full Analysis Set. Entry criteria describe adults at cardiovascular risk and do not place the population outside the packet's question.
